english: Finishers grant 'Regenerative Threshold'. Reaching Critical Health consumes Regenerative Threshold to restore 10 HP and start Health Regeneration.

source.text:
2 Piece | Regenerative Threshold

On Finisher:
Grants Regenerative Threshold.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Consumes Regenerative Threshold.
Restores 10 HP and begins Health Regeneration.
